affectedPublicSurfaces: None. This slice adds two live-marked smoke tests (tests/integration/, ADR-040 live lane — excluded from PR CI) exercising the already-merged agent runner path against the OpenAI API and the TikTok sandbox shop. No route, asset, schema, migration or deployed frontend artifact changes. The public-release classification is a false positive of the same shape #1145 documented: the classifier matches 'smoke' in the issue body because the issue IS the smoke-test issue. The plan is written honestly rather than rewording the issue to dodge the classifier.

candidateVerificationJourney.restrictedRoute: Local live-marked pytest runs on feature/issue-1124-live-smokes with operator-supplied credentials. No VPS deployment occurs; no public traffic is affected. Writes go exclusively to the TikTok SANDBOX shop per ADR-068.

journeys.name: read-only-live-smoke
assertions: a real GPT-5.4 nano run over the composed prompt + real tool registry reaches stop_reason=final_response using read-only tools against the production-read credential
every emitted event persists as workflow_run_events rows with continuous sequence numbers

journeys.name: write-path-live-smoke
assertions: a CONFIRM-class write pauses the run (paused_for_confirmation), resumes on approval, executes exactly once through the ToolExecution ledger (claim-then-execute row asserted)
compare-before-write basis check runs before signing; the write lands on the SANDBOX shop only
a simulated redelivery of the same tool_call_id returns the stored sanitized result with zero additional vendor calls

htmlRoutes: No HTML route or asset changes in this slice — two test files plus wave-manifest registration.

migrationCompatibility.notes: No migration. The smokes consume existing tables (workflow_runs, workflow_run_events, tool_executions) through the application's own code paths only.

rollbackAssertion.preCutoverFailureBehavior: Do not merge. Nothing depends on the smoke files; the wave's state is unchanged without them.
rollbackAssertion.postCutoverFailureBehavior: Revert the commit — removes only test files. Sandbox-shop mutations are confined to the sandbox tenant; no production surface exists to roll back.

doNotInfer: These smokes prove the composed loop executes end-to-end; they do NOT prove production-write readiness (ADR-068 unlock list unaffected), browser/SSE behavior (#1133 owns that), or impact-reading correctness (P-IM's backdated reading is a separate checkpoint item.)
The OpenAI key and sandbox-write TikTok credential are operator-supplied at run time and never committed; a missing credential is a SKIP with reason, never a fake green.
